note: Curated walking tour. Stops are features of the model (by key). tours.title: HKU essentials: Centennial Campus to the Main Building
tours.summary: From HKU MTR station through the Centennial Campus and the Main Library to the declared monuments of the old campus: the Main Building, Hung Hing Ying, Eliot Hall and May Hall.

stops.text: HKU station on the MTR Island Line, below the campus; its exits lead up to the Centennial Campus and Pok Fu Lam Road.
Centennial Gate: the entrance to the Centennial Campus.
The Jockey Club Tower on the Centennial Campus; a café and a bank branch are mapped inside.
Run Run Shaw Tower; the Music Library and a restaurant are mapped inside.
Lee Shau Kee Lecture Centre, with large lecture theatres; a restaurant is mapped inside.
Library Building (New Wing): the HKU Main Library.
Fung Ping Shan Building, home of the University Museum and Art Gallery; its exterior is a declared monument.
Main Building: the University's first building, opened in 1912, around two courtyards. Its exterior is a declared monument.
Sun Yat-sen Place, the open square by the Main Building.
Hung Hing Ying Building (1919), a declared monument.
Chong Yuet Ming Amenities Centre: cafés and fast food are mapped inside.
Eliot Hall (1914) and, next to it, May Hall (1915): former halls of residence, both declared monuments.
Meng Wah Complex: the University Health Service is mapped inside.
